bugLogs.title: Missing alternative text on product images (shoe-red.jpg, shoe-green.jpg)
steps_to_reproduce: 1. Open the product listing page in a browser.
2. Locate the images with filenames "shoe-red.jpg" and "shoe-green.jpg".
3. Navigate the page with a screen reader (e.g., NVDA, VoiceOver).
4. Observe that the screen reader announces "image" with no description for each image.
bugLogs.expected_behavior: Each element must provide a text alternative via a non‑empty alt attribute, an aria-label, an aria-labelledby reference, a title, or be explicitly marked as decorative with alt="" and role="presentation".
bugLogs.actual_behavior: The elements are rendered as and with no alt, aria-label, aria-labelledby, title, or role attributes.
bugLogs.suggested_fix: Add descriptive alt text to each image, or mark them as decorative if they convey no information. Example: html If the images are purely decorative, use: html
